summary: Maintain keyed agent harness reductions in canonical order

replay.detail: Default production Store readers and projections are unchanged. The opt-in source operator has no GET or per-commit history replay fallback; incomplete populated installation remains unavailable.

schema.detail: Explicit View registration adds local_agent_ordered_nodes, local_agent_ordered_roots and local_agent_harness_rows tables. No numeric core schema version change and no default registration or table installation. These are local rebuildable derived rows, not replicated identity.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and shared projection digests are unchanged. This opt-in kernel does not certify checkpoint restoration; source deletion or canonical mutation fences its reads pending explicit installation.

compatibility.detail: No client, socket, pairing or admission change. The new library operator is inactive in default production readers and preserves canonical observed-harness semantics in ten real Store controls.

downtime.detail: No additional default startup work or production activation. The connection-scoped keyed-read control uses five statements and 92 VM instructions at 32 and 256 sparse observations; this is not a deployed CPU or restart measurement.

manual.detail: Existing default installations need no manual step. Complete source hooks, populated/history/checkpoint installation and full card dependency certification remain separate requirements before explicit activation.

recovery.detail: Default data and recovery paths are unchanged. Opt-in tables contain rebuildable local derived rows; uncertified or mutated sources return unavailable rather than a historical fallback. This change makes no populated-store activation or restoration claim.
